data.projectDesc: A refreshed website for a legal services business focused on improving trust, clarity, and lead generation for consultations.
data.why: Our current website no longer reflects our brand and is losing qualified enquiries from potential clients.
data.problems: The site is outdated, difficult to navigate, lacks clear calls to action, and does not communicate the firm's expertise well.
data.success: We want more enquiries from people seeking legal advice and a clearer path to booking consultations.
data.objectives: Refresh branding, improve UX, support lead generation, clarify services, and showcase trust indicators.
data.prio1: Simplify the user journey for consultation enquiries
data.retain: Brand elements, trust-building content, and existing case study material should be kept where relevant.
data.replace: Outdated layout, weak CTAs, confusing navigation, and generic service presentation should be improved.
data.outcome: A modern, conversion-focused legal website that feels credible, professional, and easy to navigate on mobile and desktop.
data.audience: Adults seeking legal help, business owners, families, and professionals between 28 and 60 in Pakistan and the wider regional market.
data.audienceIndustries: SMEs, property owners, professionals, families, startups, and individuals seeking legal guidance.
data.painPoints: Legal processes feel intimidating, decisions are hard to make, and people need clear next steps before contacting a lawyer.
data.desiredActions: Request a consultation, call the office, or send a message via the website contact form.
data.successMeasure: Lead volume, conversion rate, consultation booking rate, and average enquiry quality.
data.existingData: Google Search Console is active and organic traffic is growing, but conversion rate remains inconsistent.
data.cms: Yes, I want to edit content myself
data.maintenance: A short post-launch support period only
